title: Maury Island incident: slag rains onto a boat

tellings.quote: guy sitting in a boat in Puet Sound and what appear to be UFOs of some kind are flying overhead and one of them appears to be in distress and it rains like shards of metal or slag or something all over his his boat,

plain: In 1947 a man sitting in a boat in Puget Sound, near Maury Island in Washington State, is said to have seen several UFOs fly overhead, one of them seemingly in trouble, which then rained shards of metal or slag all over his boat. The writer and researcher Peter Levenda retells it without naming a source, and ties it to a man named Fred Crisman. It is told as an early case where a UFO supposedly left physical debris behind.
